fields.title: 5. Probability and Value — No Change
fields.md:
- None of probability adjustment rules R1–R6 was satisfied by the 13F (source: state.probability_adjustment_rules). Scenarios stay at 25/50/25.
- Assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 · probability-weighted $469.6 · base $464.4 — unchanged from the first edition (formula and sources in the valuation section of the [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
- Share price update (close): Class B $592.85 (2026-11-16, [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)) — 27.7% above the base present value (formula 592.85 ÷ 464.4 − 1). With the exit P/B fixed at 1.45x, the implied BPS compounding is 10.7% (formula (592.85 × 2.411 ÷ (357.73 × 1.45))^(1/10) − 1).
- Market cap about $1,261.8 billion (formula 592.85 × 1,418,900 × 1,500) − net cash $356.9 billion − equities $335.5 billion = value assigned to operating businesses about $569.3 billion → 15.0x annualized after-tax operating earnings excluding investment income of $38.08 billion (formula 569,331 ÷ 38,080, same approximation as the first edition).
- Side note (not a basis for judgment): Form 4 filings for insider purchases of the company's own shares by two executives on 2026-11-12 (CFO Charles Chang, 2 Class A shares, $888,869.52 · General Counsel Marc Hamburg... Michael O'Sullivan, 421 Class B shares, weighted averages $593.75 and $594.40; sources: [Form 4 Chang](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526464003/xslF345X06/ownership.xml) · [Form 4 O'Sullivan](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526463989/xslF345X06/ownership.xml)) — management actions are not input to this probe's judgments.
